review_method: Deterministic source/unit/number checks plus blinded semantic review of functional content; not keyword counts

scoring.0: Expected function absent or wrong despite adequate evidence
scoring.1: Generic mention without an evidence-backed decision or design consequence
scoring.2: Evidence-correct function with a discriminating priority/hypothesis/design consequence
scoring.NA: Necessary input absent; proper refusal is scored correct contract behavior but not a demonstrated module effect

function_gate.note: Operational gate, not proof of performance or causal attribution

modules.goal_zh: 有证据的优势/失败坐标差异
functional_rubric: Correct declared populations and label semantics
Signed objective-associated coordinate contrast
Evidence identifier linked to the real comparison

modules.goal_zh: 证据强弱实际改变方向排序
functional_rubric: Reliability affects ranking rather than boilerplate
Counterevidence can change a proposed priority
Unsupported effects remain unresolved

modules.goal_zh: 区分整体优势与局部优势
functional_rubric: Region/extent bound to supplied spatial evidence
Distinguishes regional signal from global pose or shape
States whether regional emphasis is warranted

modules.goal_zh: 从统计描述到可检验的坐标设计信息
functional_rubric: Observable and intended coordinate change
Target/scale origin
Predicted discriminating response or explicit unresolved hypothesis

modules.goal_zh: 选择能表达 Analyst 方向的实际奖励修改
functional_rubric: Specific Analyst hypothesis linked to operative term
Formula represents intended coordinate response
Module-specific numerical diagnostic predicted

modules.goal_zh: 数据尺度进入核/曲率/温度/空间响应选择
functional_rubric: Spatial evidence linked to permitted scale
Data-supported versus prospective parameter distinction
Actual response range or direction can change

modules.goal_zh: 有效强度覆盖区别于 raw reward 大小
functional_rubric: Recognizes lane permissions
Dose edits target delivered RMS or coverage
Distinguishes scalar normalization from strength change

modules.goal_zh: 有根据地保留/修改基准
functional_rubric: Incumbent comparison changes the decision
Concrete failure condition linked to counterevidence
Retain/defer remains a defensible outcome

diagnostic_input_cases.purpose: Actual history task with no study outcomes
Matched optional diagnostic copy in which an offline supplied contrast reverses; correct semantic ranking/direction should respond, not replay target-specific memory
No invented enrichment, energy or coordinate direction
Supplied uncertainty/spatial scales change with truthful units; scale-sensitive design should respond when registry permits

shared_schema_anti_leakage: Do not require a module-specific effect, temporal rule, regional target or reliability ranking in all treatment schemas
error_classification: operative change with improvement or deterioration
